b1_pooling_methods.name: official_raw_max
b1_pooling_methods.description: Existing benchmark pooling: maximum frozen lane score in each exporter-stage entry.

b1_pooling_methods.name: ecdf_mean
b1_pooling_methods.description: Label-free midrank ECDF over every B lane in the chain/family/seed, then the entry mean.

b1_pooling_methods.name: ecdf_top3_mean
b1_pooling_methods.description: Label-free midrank ECDF over every B lane, then the mean of the entry's top three normalized lane scores.

two_stage.description: Secondary task-composition diagnostic. Select entries by the frozen B1 reference, rank destinations by the same family's separately frozen B2 reference, and assign zero destination recall/value to every realized entry missed by the B1 gate.

eligibility_threshold_geometry.reason: The committed candidate tables materialize eligibility only at 100 kUSD. Exact 50/250 kUSD geometry requires a full zero-inclusive early-window rebuild from raw BACI; outcome-only relabeling would not be an alternate cohort and is prohibited here.
